cultures.title: Arabic (Al-Sufi)
cultures.intro:
This sky culture reflects _Book Of The Stars_ (Arabic:كتاب الكواكب), 
written by the astronomer: Al-Ṣūfī in the 10th century. The book describes 
the 1025 stars of the 48 classical Greek constellations of Ptolemy Almagest, 
map to them the indigenous Arab star names and asterisms, and identify 44 stars as stars of the astrolabe.
cultures.introZh: 这种天空文化反映了 10 世纪天文学家 Al-Ṣūfī 所著的《星之书》（阿拉伯语：كتاب الكواكب）。这本书描述了托勒密天文学 48 个古典希腊星座的 1025 颗恒星，将当地的阿拉伯恒星名称和星群映射到它们，并将 44 颗恒星识别为星盘中的恒星。

cultures.title: Arabic (Ancient)
cultures.intro:
This Arabic sky culture contains the indigenous stars knowledge of the ancient 
Arabs living in the Arabian Peninsula prior to the Greek astronomy influence in 
the ninth century.
cultures.introZh: 这种阿拉伯天空文化包含了在九世纪希腊天文学影响之前生活在阿拉伯半岛的古代阿拉伯人的本土恒星知识。

cultures.title: Arabic (Lunar Stations)
cultures.intro:
The Arabic lunar stations describes the 28 sky areas chosen in ancient Arabia
to define the daily location of the moon during its monthly trip around the
sky.
cultures.introZh: 阿拉伯月球站描述了在古代阿拉伯选择的 28 个天空区域，以定义月球在每月绕天运行期间的每日位置。

cultures.title: Egyptian
cultures.intro:
The late Egyptian sky culture was influenced by Babylonian and Greco-Roman
astronomy. Constellations are depicted on the famous astronomical ceiling from
Denderah.
cultures.introZh: 埃及晚期的天空文化受到巴比伦和希腊罗马天文学的影响。在著名的丹德尔（Denderah）天文天花板上描绘了星座。

cultures.title: Bugis
cultures.intro:
The Bugis are an ethnic group on the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia, with a
strong seafaring and trading tradition. This sky culture has 12 constellation
line figures. It also has names for four stars and five other sky objects (the
Pleiades, the Coalsack Nebula, the Magellanic Cloud(s), the Milky Way, and
Venus). Many of the constellations reflect the seafaring tradition; the others
are of agricultural origin.
cultures.introZh: 武吉士是印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛上的一个民族，有着深厚的航海和贸易传统。这个天空文化有12个星座线图。它还有四颗恒星和其他五个天体（昴宿星、煤袋星云、麦哲伦星云、银河系和金星）的名称。许多星座反映了航海传统；其他的是农业来源。

cultures.title: Chinese
cultures.intro:
Chinese astronomy was developed independently and use its own system to connect
the stars. The traditional Chinese Sky Culture has far-reaching implications in
East Asia. In ancient China, constellations and planets were associated with
astrology.
cultures.introZh: 中国天文学是独立发展的，并使用其自身的系统来连接恒星。中国传统的天空文化在东亚具有深远的影响。在中国古代，星座和行星与占星术有关。

cultures.title: Chinese Contemporary
cultures.intro:
The Chinese Contemporary Sky Culture is a combination of traditional Chinese
star names and modern constellations. This is the sky culture that the Chinese
actually use now, with a great practical value.
cultures.introZh: 中国当代天空文化是中国传统星名和现代星座的结合。这是中国人现在实际使用的天空文化，具有很大的实用价值。

cultures.title: Indian Vedic
cultures.intro:
Indian astronomy has a long history stretching from pre-historic to modern
times. Some of the earliest roots of Indian astronomy can be dated to the
period of Indus Valley Civilization or earlier.
cultures.introZh: 印度天文学有着悠久的历史，从史前到现代。印度天文学的一些最早起源可以追溯到印度河流域文明时期或更早。

cultures.title: Japanese Lunar Stations
cultures.intro:
The Japanese astronomy adopted the Chinese concepts and constellations, i.e.
the asterisms as well as the division of the path of the Moon into 28
"stations" (lunar mansions) as a frame of reference in right ascension.
cultures.introZh: 日本天文学采用中国的概念和星座，即星空以及将月球的路径划分为28个“月台”（月球大厦），作为右升中的参照系。

cultures.title: Korean
cultures.intro:
The Chinese, Korean, and Japanese constellations have the same origin and look
very similar in shape. They are represented respectively in the Dun Huang
starmap from the 8th century, the _Cheon-Sang-Yeol-Cha-Bun-Ya-Ji-Do_ map and in
the Kitora skymap painted in the 7th to 8th century CE. Their positions and
their names are similar in the Chinese alphabet. The name of the constellations
first appear in the Records of the Grand Historian (史記) in Han dynasty
describing Xia dynasty in about 2000 BCE.
cultures.introZh: 中国，韩国和日本星座具有相同的起源，并且外观非常相似。它们分别在公元8世纪的敦煌星图，天上尚乐，查邦·雅·吉多地图和公元7至8世纪绘制的Kitora天空图中表示。它们的位置和名称在中文字母中相似。星座的名称最早出现在公元前2000年的汉朝记载夏朝的史记大史中。

cultures.title: Mandar
cultures.intro:
The Mandar are an ethnic group on the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia, with a
strong seafaring and trading tradition. The sailors used stars and asterisms to
pinpoint the cardinal directions.
cultures.introZh: 曼达尔人是印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛上的一个民族，有着深厚的航海和贸易传统。水手们使用星星和星座来确定主要方向。

cultures.title: Mongolian
cultures.intro:
Mongolian are nomads living on a large territory of central Asia. Their culture
is influenced by the Far Eastern (Chinese) and the Near Eastern (Persian,
Babylonian, Greek) cultures.
cultures.introZh: 蒙古人是游牧民族，生活在中亚大片地区。他们的文化受到远东（中国）和近东（波斯，巴比伦，希腊）文化的影响。

cultures.title: Siberian
cultures.intro:
Siberia is the Asian part of Russia, i.e. the northern third of the Asian
continent. As it belongs to Russia, the modern constellations are used there
since many centuries.
cultures.introZh: 西伯利亚是俄罗斯的亚洲部分，即亚洲大陆的北部三分之一。由于它属于俄罗斯，因此已有数百年的历史了。

cultures.title: Belarusian
cultures.intro:
Astronomy constellations found in Belarus, a country in Eastern Europe bordered
by Russia to the northeast, Ukraine to the south, Poland to the west, and
Lithuania and Latvia to the northwest.
cultures.introZh: 白俄罗斯是东欧的一个国家，东北与俄罗斯接壤，南与乌克兰接壤，西与波兰接壤，西北与立陶宛和拉脱维亚接壤，因此在天文星座中发现了天文学星座。

cultures.title: Norse
cultures.intro:
The norse culture is considered as originally North Germanic. The pre-Christian
Scandinavian folklore with Odin as main god was transformed into a Christian
culture.
cultures.introZh: 北欧文化最初被认为是北日耳曼语。以奥丁为主要神灵的前基督教斯堪的纳维亚民间传说被转变为基督教文化。

cultures.title: Romanian
cultures.intro:
Romania is a land in southeast Europe. Romanian popular stellar mythology is a
mixture of several historical epochs from pre-Christian to modern.
cultures.introZh: 罗马尼亚是东南欧的土地。罗马尼亚流行的恒星神话是从前基督教到现代的几个历史时期的混合。

cultures.title: Ruelle
cultures.intro:
_Alexandre Ruelle_ was an astronomy professor at the Paris Observatory. In
1786, he drew a star chart for the general public (in the service of
education), titled `Nouvelle Uranographie ou méthode très facile pour apprendre
les constellations`. This chart shows 70 constellation line figures for the
entire sky.
cultures.introZh: _Alexandre Ruelle_ 是巴黎天文台的天文学教授。 1786 年，他为大众绘制了一张星图（为教育服务），标题为“Nouvelle Uranographie ou methode très facile pour apprendre les constellations”。这张图表显示了整个天空的 70 个星座线图。

cultures.title: Sami
cultures.intro:
The Sami people are considered to be the native population of northern Norway,
Sweden, Finland and West Russia (the Kola Peninsula).
cultures.introZh: 萨米人被认为是挪威北部，瑞典，芬兰和俄罗斯西部（可拉半岛）的原住民。

cultures.title: Sardinian
cultures.intro:
Sardinia is one of the two big islands west of Italy in the Mediterranian Sea
and south of the French island of Corsica.
cultures.introZh: 撒丁岛是意大利以西的地中海和意大利的科西嘉岛以南的两个大岛之一。

cultures.title: Western
cultures.intro:
The Western sky culture is used internationally by modern astronomers, and is
the official scheme of The International Astronomical Union. It has historical
roots in Ancient Greek astronomy, with influences from Islamic astronomy.
cultures.introZh: 西方的天空文化被现代天文学家国际使用，并且是国际天文学联合会的官方计划。它起源于古希腊天文学的历史根源，受到伊斯兰天文学的影响。

cultures.title: Western (O.Hlad)
cultures.intro:
A variation of the Western sky culture with lines reproducing the 1988 Czech
printed atlas _Hvězdná obloha 2000.0_ by Hlad et al.
cultures.introZh: 西方天空文化的一种变体，其线条再现了 Hlad 等人 1988 年在捷克印刷的地图集 Hvězdná obloha 2000.0。

cultures.title: Western (H.A.Rey)
cultures.intro:
A variation of the Western sky culture with lines reproducing the 1952 book
_The Stars - A New Way To See Them_ by H. A. Rey.
cultures.introZh: 西方天空文化的一种变体，其中的线条再现了 1952 年 H. A. Rey 所著的《星星——观看它们的新方式》一书。

cultures.title: Western (Sky & Telescope)
cultures.titleZh: 西方 (天空与望远镜杂志)
cultures.intro:
A variation of the Western sky culture with constellation figures and star
names from the popular American magazine _Sky & Telescope_.
cultures.introZh: 美国著名杂志《天空与望远镜》（Sky＆Telescope）中的星座图和星星名称代表西方天空文化的变种。

cultures.title: Blackfoot
cultures.intro:
The Blackfoot is an Algonquian-speaking tribe living in the northern Great
Plains of North America.
cultures.introZh: 黑脚人是生活在北美大平原北部的一个讲阿尔冈昆语的部落。

cultures.title: Inuit
cultures.intro:
The Inuit are the indigenous peoples in the arctic areas of America, i.e.
central and northeast Canada and Greenland. Their culture is part of the
various arctic and subarctic cultures but the term "Eskimo" refers to a much
larger group (also including peoples from Alaska and on both sides of the
Behring Strait).
cultures.introZh: 因纽特人是美国北极地区的土著人民，即加拿大中部和东北部以及格陵兰。他们的文化是北极和亚北极文化的一部分，但“爱斯基摩人”一词是指更大的群体（也包括阿拉斯加和贝林海峡两岸的人）。

cultures.title: Navajo
cultures.intro:
The Navajo are the largest Native American tribe in the United States; the
Navajo Nation extends across northeastern Arizona, southeastern Utah, and
northwestern New Mexico.
cultures.introZh: 纳瓦霍人是美国最大的美洲原住民部落。纳瓦霍族国家横跨亚利桑那州东北部，犹他州东南部和新墨西哥州西北部。

cultures.title: Tukano
cultures.intro:
Tukano is the common name for a group of indigenous tribes who live around the
northwestern region of Brazil, near Colombia and Venezuela. The group shown in
this work live on the banks of the Rio Tiquié within the Rio Negro bay in the
Amazonas State, Brazil.
cultures.introZh: 图卡诺是一群居住在巴西西北部，哥伦比亚和委内瑞拉附近的土著部落的统称。这项工作中显示的小组居住在巴西亚马逊州里约内格罗湾内的里约蒂奎河岸上。

cultures.title: Tupi-Guarani
cultures.intro:
Tupi-Guarani is a name given to a family of languages spoken by the indigenous
peoples of Brazil and other South American countries.
cultures.introZh: 图皮瓜拉尼语（Tupi-Guarani）是巴西和其他南美国家的土著人民所说的一族语言的名称。

cultures.title: Anutan
cultures.intro:
Anuta is a small island in the SE of Solomon Islands in Melanesia, inhabited by
a culturally Polynesian society. As for most Oceanic seafarers, the stars are
the most important tool for long-range navigation. The major guiding stars and
constellations are known as `carriers` (_kaavenga_), and have proper names. A
`star path` or sequence of stars (_kau panonga porau_) is followed from one
island to the next.
cultures.introZh:
阿努塔是美拉尼西亚所罗门群岛东南部的一个小岛，居住着一个文化上的波利尼西亚社会。对于大多数远洋海员来说，星空是远程导航最重要的工具。主要的引导星和星座被称为“载体”（kaavenga），并有专有名称。一个
`star path` 或星序列 (kau panonga porau) 从一个岛屿到下一个岛屿。

cultures.title: Hawaiian
cultures.intro:
These are the star lines developed by Nainoa Thompson and used by the
Polynesian Voyaging Society to navigate Polynesian sailing canoes using
traditional techniques of non instrument navigation across thousands of miles
of open ocean.
cultures.introZh: 这些是纳伊诺阿·汤普森（Nainoa Thompson）开发的星线，波利尼西亚航海学会使用这些星线使用传统的非仪器导航技术在数千英里的远洋中导航波利尼西亚帆船。

cultures.title: Kamilaroi/Euahlayi
cultures.intro:
The Kamilaroi (also known as Gomeroi) and Euahlayi peoples are Australian
Aboriginal cultural groups located in the northern part of New South Wales.
They have survived European invasion and loss of much of their country. Their
culture and connection to country remains strong, including an extensive
cultural astronomy first recorded in the 1860s.
cultures.introZh: 卡米拉罗伊人（又称戈梅罗瓦人）和Euahlayi人是位于新南威尔士州北部的澳大利亚土著文化群体。他们在欧洲的入侵和大部分国家的灭亡中幸免于难。他们的文化和与国家的联系仍然很牢固，包括1860年代首次记录的广泛的文化天文学。

cultures.title: Maori
cultures.intro:
The Maori (New Zealand) night sky is similar to the Polynesian night sky, but
differs enough to warrant its own sky culture. Maritime themes are central to
the Maori sky culture and were used extensively in nautical navigation. Like
for most other sky cultures, the rising and setting of prominent stars were
used to signal planting and harvesting seasons.
cultures.introZh: 毛利人（新西兰）的夜空与波利尼西亚的夜空相似，但差异足以保证其自身的天空文化。海上主题是毛利人天空文化的中心，在航海中得到了广泛的应用。与大多数其他天空文化一样，突出的恒星的升起和落下被用来指示播种和收获季节。

cultures.title: Tongan
cultures.intro:
As in all Polynesian star lore, Tongan sky culture descends from the practical
application of nautical navigation.
cultures.introZh: 像所有波利尼西亚的星际传说一样，汤加的天空文化源于航海的实际应用。
